messages:
deploybot: [deploybot] ALERT: Pausing 14 scheduled releases in change-window 02:00-04:00 UTC due to control-plane backpressure observed in eu-west-1. All affected releases moved to HOLD. Thread_ts=3005551234
ops-bot: Incident created: 2026-06-03-eu-controlplane — https://incidents.redwood/status/2026-06-03-eu-cp :warning:
Emma Chen: ok — which services are in that window? my mobile-notif rollout (id 345) shows as held.
Raj Patel: confirmed — kvcache-gateway, oracle-adapter, and a few smaller frontends are in eu-west. Many are multi-region though.
Mira Gomez: heads up: some of these are pinned to v2.1.3 for the security backport. We must not move pinned artifacts across region without sign-off.
Sam Ortiz: proposal: staggered reschedule — move low-risk, non-sensitive releases to us-east now; delay the rest by +3h; keep pinned ones where they are. Thoughts?
Jordan Lee: oncall here — working mitigation (control-plane throttling). ETA ~45m for next update. I agree with staggered approach.
Emma Chen: Raj, can you mark which ones are low-risk?
Raj Patel: done. low-risk ids: 345, 347, 350. pinned ids: 342, 349. Command to transfer: `deploybot transfer --ids 345,347,350 --region us-east-1`
Mira Gomez: confirming pinned list 342 & 349 — do NOT move those. They require SLA/regulatory signoff.
deploybot: Ack. Transfer queued for ids [345,347,350]. HOLD preserved for pinned ids [342,349]. Logs: https://deploy.redwood.internal/logs/3005551234
Jordan Lee: I'll update the change-window calendar (shift/reschedule entries) and ping Product/legal for cross-region approvals.
Sam Ortiz: I'll draft the release-notes blurb: "Incident caused split rollout; non-sensitive releases re-routed to us-east; remaining releases delayed for safety." Will post to #release-notes once confirmed.
Emma Chen: QA — please smoke-test the three moved canaries in us-east after transfer completes.
ops-bot: Next incident update scheduled in 30m. Severity: S2. :hourglass:
Raj Patel: FYI quantization kernel patches already validated in us-east canaries — that reduces risk for frontends.
Mira Gomez: tagging owners for pinned ids to decide rollforward tomorrow AM.
Emma Chen: TL;DR: paused 14 releases; 3 low-risk -> us-east transfer queued, 6 delayed +3h, 2 pinned remain; calendar + release notes + QA checks in progress.
deploybot: Final state recorded: transfers queued (3), rescheduled (+3h = 6), pinned hold (2), remaining holds (3). To unpause after incident: `deploybot unpause --approval-token <ops-approve>`
Jordan Lee: noted in incident runbook and ops log. If control-plane clears earlier we can revisit. closing thread for coordination — continue updates in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
